recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered photographic montage featuring a central large portrait surrounded by smaller vignettes of various characters in emotional or social scenes, framed by a distinct red and white horizontal band structure and heavy, stylized display lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Central large-scale portrait as the primary focal point
Soft-edged vignettes blending into a warm, hazy background
Bold, arched display title at the top contrasting with clean sans-serif metadata
Horizontal red bands at the mid-section creating a structural anchor
coreInvariants: Warm, golden-hour color grading across all photos
Soft focus/feathered edges on secondary images
High-contrast black outline on the primary title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central female portrait occupies the upper-middle third; smaller full-body and bust portraits orbit the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large arched title at the top and the solid red horizontal bars on the left and right margins.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large central face, moves up to the title, then spirals clockwise through the smaller character vignettes.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is a dense 'packed' montage with soft light filling the gaps.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia and golden skin tones in the photography.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red in the side bands and title fill.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Black for heavy outlines and shadows.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red elements; medium-to-low saturation in the photographic collage for a nostalgic feel.

letterConstructionRules: Arched baseline for the main title
Heavy black outer stroke with a secondary inner stroke
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact decorative serif for the brand/title paired with a functional, spaced-out sans-serif for secondary info.

candidateDirections.reason: Similar flared terminals and 70s/90s crossover feel
For the heavy weight and rounded, friendly but bold presence

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a photographic montage of diverse people in warm, golden-hour lighting. The central figure should be a smiling woman. Use soft-edge blending between images. Add solid red horizontal bars on the left and right mid-sections.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large arched title in a bold serif font at the top with a thick black outline. Below it, add metadata in a white, spaced-out condensed sans-serif. Place a list of names at the bottom in a white sans-serif with a subtle drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Are the photo edges soft and blended?
Is the color palette dominated by warm golds and deep reds?
Is the text legible against the busy background?

mustAchieve: Consistent warm lighting across all elements

postGenerationChecks: Check that the title has a thick black outline.
Ensure the central portrait is significantly larger than the others.
Verify the presence of the red horizontal side-bars.
Confirm the overall '90s film' aesthetic is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Photographic montage + Warm golden tint + Arched heavy serif title + Red horizontal framing elements.
